data.name: Help.RECALLDASHBOARD.Purpose
data.value: Shows how ready the company is for a recall: open cases, the last drill against its target, lot coverage of outbound movements, untraceable outbound movements and returns of open cases.

data.name: Help.RECALLDASHBOARD.Audience
data.value: Quality (recall owner), quality system administrator and management (read-only).

data.name: Help.RECALLDASHBOARD.Step1
data.value: Every figure on this page belongs to the selected company only.

data.name: Help.RECALLDASHBOARD.Step2
data.value: A red “Target exceeded” on the last drill or a non-zero untraceable count needs attention.

data.name: Help.RECALLDASHBOARD.Step3
data.value: The chart shows the last 12 completed drills against the target line; the band above warns when the last drill is too old.

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Purpose
data.value: Traces a lot through the whole genealogy, backward to its inputs and forward to stock, shipments and customers, and shows the gaps where a lot cannot prove where goods went.

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Audience
data.value: Quality (recall owner) and the quality system administrator.

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Step1
data.value: Search the lot number and choose the direction: backward, forward or both.

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Step2Title
data.value: Read the tree or the table

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Step2
data.value: Both views show the same nodes. Red rows are trace gaps; another company’s activity appears only as a count.

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Step3
data.value: “Download CSV” gives the same rows; “Open a recall case with this scope” opens a draft case from this trace.

data.name: Help.RECALLTRACE.Immediate
data.value: Opening a case creates a draft immediately; nothing is blocked until its scope is approved.

data.name: Help.RECALLCASES.Purpose
data.value: Lists the company’s real recall cases and drills together, newest first, with their status and progress.

data.name: Help.RECALLCASES.Audience
data.value: Everyone who follows recalls: quality, warehouse, commercial and management.

data.name: Help.RECALLCASES.Step1
data.value: Use type, status, class, product and the opening date. A class filter shows real cases only.

data.name: Help.RECALLCASES.Step2
data.value: A drill row says “Drill”, shows its result and duration, and has no class or level.

data.name: Help.RECALLDRILLS.Purpose
data.value: Plan recall drills and run them against the clock without touching stock.

data.name: Help.RECALLDRILLS.Audience
data.value: Quality assurance and the quality-system administrator.

data.name: Help.RECALLDRILLS.Step1
data.value: Add a plan: frequency, scope and next date.

data.name: Help.RECALLDRILLS.Step2
data.value: Start the timer, then complete the three steps in order: trace, scope, customer list.

data.name: Help.RECALLDRILLS.Step3
data.value: Write the result note and save it with the e-signature when the policy asks for one.

data.name: Help.RECALLEVIDENCE.Purpose

data.name: Help.RECALLEVIDENCE.Step2
data.value: Download the PDF or CSV; the SHA-256 in the export log is computed from the file’s bytes.

data.name: Help.RECALLSETTINGS.Purpose

data.value: Change the values and write a reason of at least 10 characters.

data.name: Help.RECALLSETTINGS.Step2
data.value: Save; when the policy asks, sign in the e-signature window. Every change is in the history.
